# Third-party design skills

These files are pinned, unmodified reference copies. Forge ships compact, modified
instructions in `shared/upstream-design-skills.ts`. The adaptations use Forge's
existing capabilities. This directory's example commands and paths are reference
material, and no upstream installer, data bundle or executable is imported.
